metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the `ical` CLI in C++20 (stdlib-only) under `output/`, with both required subcommands:

- Build: `cd output && cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
- Run:
  - `output/build/ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `output/build/ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/main.cpp`: CLI arg parsing, exit codes, error JSON
- `output/ical.cpp`: `.ics` lexer/unfolder + component tree parse, full `parse` JSON mapping, iTIP `itip_missing_property` warnings, and `expand` implementation (RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE + `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides incl. `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`)
- `output/rrule.cpp`: RRULE parser (emits `rscale_unsupported` warnings when applicable)
- `output/expand.cpp`: recurrence expansion engine (BYxxx + BYSETPOS, COUNT/UNTIL handling in expand layer)
- `output/tz.cpp`: VTIMEZONE transition building + TZID local→UTC conversion with `timezone_fold_ambiguous` / `nonexistent_local_time` warnings
- `output/json.cpp`: minimal JSON writer (no dependencies)
